🔑 Key Collection

  • Locate the key box beside the Main Door.
  • Enter the passcode provided via WhatsApp.
  • Twist the knob clockwise and retrieve the key.

⚡ Main Power & Light Switches (Main Hall)

  • The main power and switches are located in the staff area behind the curtain.
  • Turn on all switches labelled for lightings.
Neon Sign & Dehumidifier

TV Switch & Table Hockey Main Switch is beside the TV. Table hockey switch is below the sofa.

⚡ Main Hall Sound System

Remember to switch to AUX at all times
Switch to Bluetooth if you wish to connect via Bluetooth
For Microphone Setup
Connect the Microphone receiver into MIC1 Input
Ensure the receiver is switched 'ON'

🛋️ Relax Zone (Main Hall)

Watch YouTube
Use this remote — press the YouTube button
Select the BojioVenue account

Press YouTube on the Prism+ remote, then select the BojioVenue account. If you'd rather use your own account, that's fine — just remember to log out once you're done.

Watch Movies / VOD (TV Box)
TV Box, connected via HDMI
Go to "VOD" to watch
Use this remote to power on and navigate the EVPAD

Cycle through the TV's HDMI inputs using the Prism+ remote until you see the EVPAD home screen, then use the EVAI remote above to navigate. Once on the home screen, go to VOD to browse and watch.

⚡ Light Switches (Pantry)

Additional switches for the pantry, toilets, and karaoke room lights are located along the pantry wall.

Pantry Cabinets
🚫 Do NOT open the restricted section. At all times.
💡 In the event your trash bag breaks or the caterer doesn't provide enough, we keep extra trash bags, toilet rolls, and tissue here for you.

⚡ Light & Switches (KTV Room / Private Room)

TV & Aircon Controller
System Power Switch
Make sure it's set to DVD/CD
JBL Amp switch is at the side
⚠️ Shut down the karaoke system fully before switching off the power at the wall.

📺 TV Input / HDMI

If the karaoke screen doesn't show, go to TV inputs and select HDMI 3 (eARC/ARC).

❄️ Air-Con Switches (Located at 2nd Level)

  • Two Mitsubishi controllers operate the central air-conditioning system.
  • Press the power button to power on/off each unit.

⚡ 2nd Level Entertainment Hall

📋 After Event Instructions

Ensure ALL electronics are switched off, including Air-con on the 2nd floor.

Trash Disposal
Make sure all bins are cleared and lined bags thrown into the big bin provided
Throw the trashbag beside the blue bin near the lift
🚫 Do NOT switch off the Water Filter Dispenser or the Wifi switches — ever.
Water Filter Dispenser
Wifi switch

Before You Leave
Return the key into the key box
